title: Card 6: garam key ki 1-2 sec copy har App ki RAM me (L1). Likhna ho to tukde like#0..#9, padhte waqt jodo

callouts.green: Ring key baant-ta, ek key ki bheed nahi: ek key = ek hi machine

callouts.red: Machine A ka CPU full (crore read / sec)
callouts.green: Har App 1-2 sec me ek hi baar A se padhe (L1). Ya key ki 10 copy (score#1 .. #10), kisi se bhi padho

callouts.red: Garam key kaise pakdein? App me ginti, ya machine ka CPU achanak upar. Likhna bhi garam (like)? Ginti 10 tukdon me, padhte waqt jodo.
callouts.green: App ki copy kitni purani? 1-2 sec: score me chalta, paisa / stock me nahi

callouts.red: Parat: App ki RAM (L1) -> Redis (L2) -> DB. Neeche wali dheemi.
callouts.green: Fark: key khaali = sab DB pe (card 5, taala). Key bhari = sab ek machine pe (yahan, L1)

kyun: Ek key = ek machine, to crore read ek hi machine pe. Isliye garam key ki 1-2 sec ki copy har App apni RAM me rakhe (L1). Machine A pe har App ka 1-2 sec me ek hi chakkar
peeche: card 5 me TAALA: sirf pehla DB jaaye
ab: Raat IPL final, "live:score" key ki machine akeli mar rahi, Arpan ka score atka
agla: poora design ek saans me: file me neeche "Poora design ek saans me"
